1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure; and __at least one aero cover removably attached to said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, wherein said aero cover is configured to be selectively removed to provide access to said open rib structure__.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, __and said at least one aero cover comprises a first aero cover positioned at said first forward corner and a second aero cover positioned at said second forward corner__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure, __said first aero cover being removably attached to span and close said first section of open rib structure and said second aero cover being removably attached to span and close said second section of open rib structure__.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

6. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

7. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel, __wherein said fasteners are configured to allow removal of said aero covers without permanent deformation of said body panel__.

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress.

11. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa, __and wherein said aero covers are made from a material having a lower modulus than said body panel__.

12. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers, __and said aero covers are molded from polypropylene reinforced with a lower percentage of glass fibers than said body panel__.

13. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm, __and said aero covers have a thickness less than said body panel thickness__.

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover removably attached to and spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover removably attached to and spanning and closing said second open rib structure, __wherein said aero covers are configured to be selectively removed to provide access to said open rib structures without permanent deformation of said body panel__.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners, __and said first and second aero covers are independently removable from said first and second sections__.

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section.

18. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

19. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

20. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.
